leadText:
Bloom Canyon is an -exclusive location that was featured in Those Darn Electabuzz!. It was unnamed in the Japanese version.

Bloom Canyon is part of a mountainous area, with unpredictable conditions including whirlpools and strong winds. Star baseballer Corey Demario often trains in the area with his nicknamed Don. Corey and his family also operate a ranch nearby.
